about.title: Hello
about.text: I'm a first-year Master's student in Marketing and Innovation Strategy at IAE Saint-Étienne, on a double degree with ENCG Settat, and I focus on strategic and digital marketing. Content creation is my passion, and I'm comfortable on both sides: I analyze the data, then turn it into images, videos and ideas. A former active member of student clubs and AIESEC, I moved to France in 2026 for my Master's.
